name: dsc-llm-tune
description: dsc 插件 dsc-llm-tune:让用户直接设定 LLM 请求参数(温度、top_p、max_tokens、停止词),不提供预设;与 dsc-humanize 互斥;已接入宿主插件设置表面,JSON 文本导入保留为兼容路径
author: omds-chat

description.zh-CN: 直接设定 LLM 请求参数的 dsc 插件:温度、top_p、max_tokens 与停止词由用户输入,不提供预设;与 dsc-humanize 互斥;已接入宿主插件设置表面,JSON 文本导入保留为兼容路径
description.en-US: A dsc plugin that lets you set LLM request parameters directly: temperature, top_p, max_tokens and stop sequences come from you, with no presets; mutually exclusive with dsc-humanize; values are set in the host plugin settings page, with the JSON import kept as the compatibility path
